decks.notes: The main focus of this Jeskai Control deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck utilizes various spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan, such as Supreme Verdict, Prismatic Ending, and Wrath of the Skies. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Tune the Narrative and Snapcaster Mage to ensure card advantage and versatility. The win condition of the deck is to establish board control with powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, and close out the game with efficient removal spells and direct damage.

The deck focuses on aggressive Boros creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, along with support from cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls. The deck also includes various removal options like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board. Additionally, cards like Thraben Charm and Static Prison provide disruption to the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to ensure consistent casting of spells and to support the aggressive game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Burning Inquiry and Faithless Looting to bring back powerful creatures like Hollow One and Vengevine for strong early game aggression. The deck also utilizes cards like Blazing Rootwalla and Marauding Mako to push for damage early on. The inclusion of cards like Detective's Phoenix and Arena of Glory provide additional value and potential disruption. Lightning Bolt and Tarfire are included for removal, while the land base supports aggressive play with fetchlands and a mix of red and green mana sources.

The key concept of this deck is to efficiently and quickly cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty into play from the graveyard using cards like Persist and Faithless Looting. Utilizing Nethergoyf and Dragon's Rage Channeler for backup aggression, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its reanimated threats while controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Tarfire. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Street Wraith helps dig for combo pieces, making this Combo - Reanimator deck a formidable force in a 1 vs 1 Modern format.

This deck focuses on using Amulet of Vigor to cheat the mana system and quickly ramp into playing Primeval Titan, allowing for explosive combos and powerful board presence. By assembling the right combination of lands and utilizing cards like Explore and Scapeshift, the deck can quickly search for key lands and overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures. With the right sequencing and careful resource management, players can create a formidable board state that is challenging to overcome.

The deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy while using flicker effects to disrupt opponents' gameplay. By constantly blinking creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd or Overlord of the Balemurk, the deck can generate value and maintain board presence. Additionally, cards like Relic of Progenitus and Thoughtseize help control the opponent's graveyard and hand, while cards like Fatal Push provide removal options. The mana base supports the deck's color requirements and allows for flexibility in casting spells.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with the Death's Shadow archetype, utilizing cards like Death's Shadow, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Grim Lavamancer to deal damage quickly to the opponent. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Stubborn Denial to control the game and protect your threats. The inclusion of cards like Cecil, Dark Knight and Psychic Frog provide additional utility and versatility to the deck's strategy. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while also including lands like Mishra's Bauble for extra card advantage.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent while also utilizing "blink" effects to protect your creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By blinking creatures like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Emperor of Bones, you can trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities multiple times and keep your threats safe from removal spells. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the game and maintain tempo. The mana base is flexible and includes a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to all colors of mana.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive creature plays, aiming to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures and burn spells. The key strategy revolves around early creature aggression, using cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to put pressure on the opponent. The deck's multi-color mana base allows for flexibility in casting spells like Tribal Flames and Leyline Binding, while Leyline of the Guildpact helps to boost the power of the deck's creatures. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly through a combination of creature damage and burn spells.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Scion of Draco to aggressively attack the opponent. Cards like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames provide additional damage and removal options, while Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help control the board. The deck also includes strong utility lands like Arid Mesa and Flooded Strand to ensure consistent mana fixing. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient threats and removal spells.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. The key strategy is to play efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury alongside powerful support cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory. The deck also uses cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and apply pressure. With a mix of creature aggression and burn spells, this deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures like Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker to generate a strong board presence, while also using Writhing Chrysalis to create additional creatures. The key strategy involves using Blade of the Bloodchief to pump up these creatures and take advantage of their abilities. Combining these creatures with powerful spells like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble allows for control over the board and the ability to overwhelm opponents quickly. The deck also includes cards like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures to support the combo and ensure its success.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the pieces needed to reanimate powerful creatures like Emrakul and Griselbrand with cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Tainted Indulgence. By leveraging powerful instant spells like Solitude and Force of Negation to protect the combo, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with big threats coming back from the graveyard. The inclusion of Atraxa, Grand Unifier provides additional value by allowing for more efficient casting of the deck's instant spells. Thoughtseize helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Prismatic Ending provide versatile removal options.

The main focus of this Jeskai Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Counterspell, Wrath of the Skies, and Solitude, while generating card advantage with Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Tune the Narrative. The deck also utilizes powerful finishers like Lórien Revealed and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to close out the game. Overall, the strategy revolves around controlling the pace of the game and outvaluing the opponent with efficient spells.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combo of cards and abilities to manipulate the game without relying on traditional lands. By utilizing cards like Fallaji Archaeologist, Thundertrap Trainer, and Lotus Bloom, players can generate the necessary resources to power up cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Hydroelectric Specimen for devastating effects. Additional cards like Disrupting Shoal and Flare of Denial help to control the opponent's moves while cards like Whir of Invention and Sea Gate Restoration provide card advantage and flexibility in the strategy. This deck focuses on creating a unique and powerful win condition through non-traditional means.

This deck focuses on using Birthing Ritual to ramp up quickly and efficiently, allowing you to play your high-cost creatures early in the game. The deck also includes counter spells like Force of Negation and Flare of Denial to protect your board state. Lórien Revealed and Dismember provide additional removal options, while cards like Shardless Agent and Thundertrap Trainer help you maintain card advantage. The deck's creatures have synergy with each other, allowing you to overwhelm your opponent with a combination of aggression and control.

This deck focuses on fast-paced aggression using a combination of powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Scion of Draco alongside efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help to boost the effectiveness of your creatures, while Stubborn Denial provides protection. The mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for a variety of color options thanks to Tribal Flames. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently with a mix of creature pressure and versatile spells.

This aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful creatures such as Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Scion of Draco to deal significant damage to the opponent. It also includes disruptive spells like Stubborn Denial and Leyline Binding to control the battlefield. The key strategy is to apply pressure early on with efficient creatures and burn spells like Lightning Bolt, while maintaining control with cards like Leyline of the Guildpact. Additionally, the deck utilizes mana-fixing lands and cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to ensure consistency and flexibility in its aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly through cards like Arboreal Grazer and Explore to get to its combo piece, Primeval Titan. The key play involves using Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and generate large amounts of mana to play Primeval Titan and search for lands like Gruul Turf and Lotus Field. By utilizing cards like Scapeshift and Urza's Saga, the deck can quickly assemble a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent with landfall triggers and powerful creatures.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride to quickly deal damage to the opponent. Support cards like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm help control the board while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional value and card advantage. The deck also includes some prison effects like Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive creatures and powerful spells to secure a quick victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly and efficiently deploying creatures and utilizing burn spells to deal damage to the opponent and their creatures. The key strategy involves aggressively attacking with powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, while using Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and push through damage. Seasoned Pyromancer provides card advantage and tokens, while Static Prison and Arena of Glory help to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to be fast and relentless in its assault on the opponent.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays supported by burn spells and token generation. The key strategy revolves around quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mix of efficient creatures like Ragavan and Seasoned Pyromancer, while also utilizing Ajani and Ocelot Pride for extra creature tokens. The deck also includes removal and disruption cards like Galvanic Discharge and Static Prison to control the board state, allowing for consistent pressure and control throughout the game. The mana base is optimized for quick access to all necessary colors.

This deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between creatures with +1/+1 counters and sacrificing them to generate mana and control the board. By ramping up with mana-producing lands and spells, the deck aims to quickly build up a powerful board presence with creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and Basking Broodscale. Emrakul, the Promised End serves as a game-ending threat, while cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Sowing Mycospawn provide additional value from sacrificing creatures. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command to control the battlefield and disrupt opponent's strategies.

The main idea of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal, and hand disruption. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict while also disrupting the opponent's hand with Thoughtseize and Sink into Stupor. The deck also has graveyard recursion with Unearth and Cling to Dust to provide additional value. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to control the game in order to secure a win through resource management and disruption.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures, then using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Tainted Indulgence to bring them back into play for a game-winning combo. Cards like Psychic Frog and Solitude help control the board while setting up the reanimation combo, with tools like Ephemerate and Thoughtseize providing utility and disruption. The deck also includes a small amount of removal and protection to ensure the combo can go off successfully.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through a combination of counter spells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gradually building up card advantage and controlling the board. By combining powerful control elements with versatile threats like Teferi, Time Raveler and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, the deck can adapt to various strategies and efficiently control the game until it can secure a win condition. The deck's mana base and card selection are optimized to support a reactive and controlling playstyle throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to create a powerful combo using cards that do not require lands to be effective. The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Fallaji Archaeologist, Hydroelectric Specimen, Tameshi, Reality Architect, and Thundertrap Trainer to generate a powerful win condition. Other key cards like Disrupting Shoal, Flare of Denial, and Force of Negation help to disrupt opponent's strategies while cards like Whir of Invention and Sea Gate Restoration provide card advantage and additional combo pieces. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its unique landless combo strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of powerful cards and abilities to assemble a win condition without relying on traditional land cards. By leveraging a variety of creatures, artifacts, and instant spells, the deck aims to quickly control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up a quick and unexpected win using cards like Goblin Charbelcher. The key strategy is to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent through a unique and unexpected combo approach that doesn't require traditional land resources.

This deck focuses on putting creatures with cycling into the graveyard in order to cast Living End and bring them all back onto the battlefield. The key strategy is to cycle through your deck quickly, utilizing cards like Street Wraith and Shardless Agent, while also disrupting your opponent's game plan with counter spells and hand disruption. Once you have enough creatures in the graveyard, you can unleash the powerful combo of Living End to overwhelm your opponent with a sudden influx of creatures onto the battlefield.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with creatures to cast Living End, a powerful sorcery that returns all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield while exiling all other creatures. This strategy aims to overwhelm opponents with a strong board presence and disrupt their game plan. The deck includes a variety of creatures with cycling abilities to help fill the graveyard efficiently, as well as disruption spells like Force of Negation to protect the combo. The deck aims to win through a combination of aggression and disruption, making it a versatile and powerful combo deck in the Modern format.

The deck revolves around putting powerful creatures into the graveyard and then bringing them back to the battlefield to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Faithless Looting and Persist, as well as Unearth and Graveyard Trespasser, the deck can quickly fill the graveyard with key threats. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Spell Pierce helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan while the creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones put immense pressure on the opponent once they hit the battlefield. The deck combines reanimation and disruptive elements to create a potent combo strategy.
